description: This file defines a class 'MultipleImplicitSubscriptionGrain' which is an Orleans grain implementing implicit stream subscriptions. It subscribes to 'red' and 'blue' streams and maintains counters for received events.

classes.name: MultipleImplicitSubscriptionGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain with implicit stream subscriptions to 'red' and 'blue' streams, maintaining counters for each.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Overrides the activation method to set up stream subscriptions and initialize counters.

methods.name: GetCounters
methods.description: Returns current counts of red and blue stream events received.
